newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QMC says magnesia prices affect performance.
newsitem.headline: QMC says magnesia prices affect performance.

text.p: Queensland Metals Corporation Ltd (QMC) said on Friday its performance continued to be adversely affected by lower magnesia prices although these now appeared to have stabilised.
On the cost side of the ledger, QMC said it was reviewing all project costs that had been capitalised, which would affect the financial results for the year to June 30.
The company posted a half year net loss of A$7.28 million, while its previous full year result was a net loss of A$8.33 milion.

QMC said commissioning of some of the expanded deadburn plant had commenced with the start up of the new shaft kiln planned for August, construction of which was likely to be completed under the revised budget of A$18.5 million.
By 11.00 a.m. (0100 GMT), QMC Metals shares were steady at A$1.30 on only one trade of 1,234 shares.
